trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Why v2.3.0:** It's the most recent release that was healthy in production. The deploy history isn't listed in order, but sorting by sequence shows both releases after v2.3.0 were unhealthy: v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is now live in all three regions, and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before.
- **Incident:** It describes the failure, the rollback and the next step, which is finding the root cause of the problem in v2.3.1 before redeploying it. My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that no incident had been created before sending it again, so there's only one and on-call was only paged once.
